column1: Impact: fix hang/crash on ia64 under high load

column2: but the simplest patch by far.

column1: called ""implicitly"" from within scheduler after exit_notify(). This
means we can race with the parent doing release_task()
before __cleanup_signal() to make sure ->signal can't be freed under
task_rq(tsk)->lock. Note that task_rq_unlock_wait() doesn't care
about the case when tsk changes cpu/rq under us
